variants.description: The standard marked route from Preikestolen BaseCamp to the safe plateau arrival and back on the same trail. variants.accessNotes: Start at the signed trail entrance beside Preikestolen Parking/BaseCamp. The route is open year-round. In winter and other off-season conditions, check current weather and trailhead advice, start early enough to return before dark, and use warm waterproof layers, hiking boots and spikes/crampons when snow or ice warrants them. Follow the red T markings on the standard out-and-back.
warnings: The 604 m plateau edge is unprotected; keep a safe distance and supervise children.
Snow and ice can make the route substantially more challenging. Use spikes/crampons when conditions or trailhead staff advise them, and account for short daylight from September through March.
